name: When Someone Dies
overview: Scripture teaches that death is a significant and sacred event in the life of a believer, as the death of God's saints is precious in His sight (Psalms 116:15). At death, the body returns to the earth while the spirit returns to God who gave it (Ecclesiastes 12:7), affirming God's sovereignty over life and death. The Lord’s care and provision extend through life and into the reality of death, as He is our shepherd who meets all our needs (Psalms 23:1). Even before birth, God’s intimate knowledge and purpose for each person are established (Jeremiah 1:5), reminding us that life and death are under His sovereign plan.
